Definition: from G1722 and G906; to throw on, i.e. (figuratively) subject to (eternal punishment):--cast into.
BiblicalUsage: The word embállō carries the sense of cast into. In Luke 12:5, the text says "which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, embállō means cast into, nothing more and nothing less.
